concepts.title: 偏心伞盖的怯生蘑菇
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original enemy appearance concept for a simple geometric cartoon 3D action game.
Primary request: a strange, timid mushroom creature that attacks with spores and retracts underground. The emotional idea is the shy Scaredy-shroom from Plants vs. Zombies, reinterpreted as an original deliberately asymmetric creature with the eccentric silhouette design sensibility of Risk of Rain 2. It is a mushroom, never a mole or a humanoid wearing a mushroom hat.
Subject: one squat living mushroom with a very large off-center lopsided cap. One side of the cap overhangs far lower than the other, partly hiding a small nervous eye; the other eye is larger, visible and set lower. The short pale stem curves sideways under the uneven weight. A tiny puckered spore mouth sits off-center. Its timid, hunched character should coexist with an odd, slightly uncanny alien-plant feeling. Use a few broad irregular cap patches, not decorative clutter. The mushroom body merges into a blunt rounded stem base, without legs or feet.
Style/medium: clean stylized low-poly 3D concept render; extremely simple broad faceted volumes, softly beveled edges, matte flat-color surfaces, 4 to 5 main colors, no fine texture. Deliberate designed imbalance rather than a tidy mirrored cute mascot. This must be practical to recreate as a lightweight 3D game enemy. Use a muted plum/purple cap, a pale desaturated sage/cream stem, and small warm light eyes; readable in a bright cartoon forest.
Composition/framing: ONE complete creature, large and clearly readable, front three-quarter view, plain warm light-gray background and a small soft contact shadow. Keep the whole cap and stem visible with generous margin. Show the normal above-ground pose only.
Constraints: asymmetry must be unmistakable in silhouette and facial placement, not merely different colored spots. Keep the overall shape bold and simple. No arms, no hands, no fur, no mole snout, no claws, no goggles, no clothes, no shoes, no gun, no ornate fantasy armor, no humanoid skeleton, no extra characters, no environment, no UI, no text, no labels, no watermark. No gore, realistic rot, intricate gills or dense surface detail.

concepts.title: 歪帽鬼火法师
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original enemy appearance concept for a simple geometric cartoon 3D action game.
Primary request: a small living will-o'-the-wisp wearing a wizard hat; a ghostly spellcaster with no legs or feet. Make it peculiar and deliberately asymmetric, with the eccentric designed silhouette sensibility of Risk of Rain 2, while preserving simple geometric cartoon forms suitable for a bright stylized forest.
Subject: ONE small floating ghost flame. The main body is a compact irregular cyan/teal luminous flame mass with an off-center face: one large narrow luminous eye and one much smaller eye, with a curious slightly mischievous uncanny expression. It wears a solid matte indigo-purple wizard hat, oversized, leaning sideways with a strongly bent crooked tip and an uneven broad brim. The hat tilts in one direction, while the lower ghost flame curves in the opposite direction, creating a clear unbalanced S-shaped silhouette. No ordinary torso or robe: the flame body directly tapers into a translucent spectral lower tail, fading near its tip. Use only two or three broad asymmetric flame lobes; one short side flare can suggest a gesture, but there are no human hands or arms. Wizard identity comes from the hat and magical body, no staff required.
Style/medium: clean stylized low-poly 3D concept render, simple broad faceted volumes and softly beveled hat edges, 4 to 5 principal colors. The hat has one simple band; the spirit has a modest luminous core, readable surface shapes and a gentle translucent fade along its tail. It should feel like a strange little magical creature, not a tidy symmetrical toy or a person in a sheet.
Composition/framing: ONE full creature, large front three-quarter view, entire hat tip and entire curved tail visible, plain warm light-gray background with a very soft separated shadow suggesting hovering. Clear thumbnail-scale silhouette.
Constraints: conspicuous asymmetry in the actual hat, body mass and tail, not only facial markings. No feet, legs, boots, trousers, skirt, robe, human body, mushroom cap, weapons, staff, floating rocks, extra characters, scenery, UI, lettering, watermark or ornate accessories. No photorealistic smoke, excessive particles, noisy flame filaments, overexposed bloom or dense surface details.
